title: fix(cli): read and write CLI JSON files as UTF-8

+from click.testing import CliRunner
+
+import dynamiq.cli.commands.dataset as module
+from dynamiq.cli.commands.dataset import dataset
+
+
+def test_dataset_download_writes_utf8_file(cli_ctx, recording_api, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    real_open = open
+
+    def cp1252_default_open(file, mode="r", *args, encoding=None, **kwargs):
+        return real_open(file, mode, *args, encoding=encoding or "cp1252", **kwargs)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "open", cp1252_default_open, raising=False)
+    text = '{"question": "日本語 – résumé"}'
+    recording_api.get = lambda path, **kw: type("R", (), {"status_code": 200, "text": text})()
+    out = tmp_path / "version.json"
+
+    result = CliRunner().invoke(dataset, ["download", "v1", "--out", str(out)], obj=cli_ctx)
+
+    assert result.exit_code == 0, result.output
+    assert out.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == text

+def _cp1252_default_open(monkeypatch, module):
+    """Make open() without an explicit encoding behave like a cp1252 locale (e.g. Windows)."""
+    real_open = open
+
+    def fake_open(file, mode="r", *args, encoding=None, **kwargs):
+        return real_open(file, mode, *args, encoding=encoding or "cp1252", **kwargs)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "open", fake_open, raising=False)
+

+import click
+import pytest
+
+import dynamiq.cli.commands.workflow as module
+from dynamiq.cli.commands.workflow import read_json_arg
+
+
+def _cp1252_default_open(monkeypatch):
+    real_open = open
+
+    def fake_open(file, mode="r", *args, encoding=None, **kwargs):
+        return real_open(file, mode, *args, encoding=encoding or "cp1252", **kwargs)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "open", fake_open, raising=False)
+
+
+def test_read_json_arg_reads_file_as_utf8(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    _cp1252_default_open(monkeypatch)
+    path = tmp_path / "items.json"
+    path.write_text('[{"q": "日本語 – résumé"}]', encoding="utf-8")
+
+    assert read_json_arg(f"@{path}") == [{"q": "日本語 – résumé"}]
+
+
+def test_read_json_arg_non_utf8_file_is_click_exception(tmp_path):
+    path = tmp_path / "items.json"
+    path.write_bytes('["résumé"]'.encode("cp1252"))
+
+    with pytest.raises(click.ClickException, match="not valid UTF-8"):
+        read_json_arg(f"@{path}")
